description.default: The district council is drafting next year's neighbourhood plan and wants to know which improvements residents back. Approve as many of the sixteen proposals as you like; the most approved ones go into the plan and are funded first.
description.en: The district council is drafting next year's neighbourhood plan and wants to know which improvements residents back. Approve as many of the sixteen proposals as you like; the most approved ones go into the plan and are funded first.

description.ca: El districte prepara el pla de barri de l'any vinent i vol saber a quines millores donen suport els veïns. Aprova tantes propostes de les setze com vulguis; les més aprovades entraran al pla i es finançaran primer.
